## Complete Execution Run
```{r test_pipeline, message=FALSE}
library(spatialDESeq)
se <- make_mock_spatial()
analyzed <- spatialDESeq(se, design = ~ condition, radius = 2.5)
head(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(analyzed))
```
